latest_release.name: v3.4.2
latest_release.body:
Some more bug fixes and a new FUTO Backups version in this one!

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug fixes
* fix(web): prevent duplicate combobox keys on unknown camera make by @abdul-karim-mia in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33189
* fix(web): hide slideshow play/pause without autoplay by @jrasm91 in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33219
* fix: filename alignment detail panel by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33240
* fix(web): hash external styles for csp by @bo0tzz in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33275
* fix: integrity report downloads by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33239
* fix: prometheus exporter listening by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33450
* fix(server): drop range=pc on vaapi by @mertalev in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33262

## New Contributors
* @abdul-karim-mia made their first contribution in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33189

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/compare/v3.4.1...v3.4.2

hot_issues.title: Certain DNG files cannot be processed
Images appear to be randomly corrupted (at least on RK build) with no logs or known reason
Mobile photo backup keeps retrying already-uploaded assets
Immich iOS app doesn't upload but prepares images and taking my space
Hardware acceleration cause video play with stuttering effect

discussions.title: [Feature] ML: compile/warm models at startup, then release them (preload without pinning)
[Feature] Add an option to hide iCloud Shared Albums from album pickers on iOS
[Feature] Multiple server profiles / quick server switching in the mobile app
Don’t Allow option when deleting a photo from Immich iOS app
[Feature] Allow 1:1 mapping of phone album to a directory for uploads
Immich on PostgreSQL 19 with CloudNativePG: vchord images from the maintained pgsty fork
